theorem QOU.MathlibExt.branch_im {y : ℂ} :
(2 * Complex.log y - 3 * Complex.log (1 - y)).im = 2 * y.arg - 3 * (1 - y).arg

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.branch_eq_of_window {y : ℂ} {n : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (h1y : 1 - y ≠ 0) (hsq : y ^ 2 = (1 - y) ^ 3) (hlo : (2 * ↑n - 2) * Real.pi < (2 * Complex.log y - 3 * Complex.log (1 - y)).im) (hhi : (2 * Complex.log y - 3 * Complex.log (1 - y)).im < (2 * ↑n + 2) * Real.pi) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.eq_intMul_two_pi_I_of_exp_eq_one {u : ℂ} {n : ℤ} (h : Complex.exp u = 1) (hlo : (2 * ↑n - 2) * Real.pi < u.im) (hhi : u.im < (2 * ↑n + 2) * Real.pi) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.cRogersL_add_inv_of_im_neg {z : ℂ} (h : z.im < 0) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.cRogersL_add_inv_of_im_pos {z : ℂ} (h : 0 < z.im) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.clog_pentagon_expansions {x y : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hy0 : 0 < y) (hy1 : y < 1) :
Complex.log (↑(1 - x) / ↑(1 - x * y)) = Complex.log ↑(1 - x) - Complex.log ↑(1 - x * y) ∧ Complex.log (↑x * ↑y) = Complex.log ↑x + Complex.log ↑y

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.pentagon_args_pos {x y : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hy0 : 0 < y) (hy1 : y < 1) :
0 < 1 - x * y ∧ 0 < (1 - x) / (1 - x * y) ∧ 0 < (1 - y) / (1 - x * y) ∧ 0 < x * (1 - y) / (1 - x * y) ∧ 0 < y * (1 - x) / (1 - x * y)
